detailed_findings.finding: The proof establishes a slightly stronger statement, 0 <= x - floor(x) < 1, which directly implies the target inequality.

reason: The proof correctly derives the standard floor inequality m <= x < m + 1 for m = floor(x), hence 0 <= x - floor(x) < 1, which implies the lemma x - floor(x) < 1 for all real x. The argument is complete and uses only allowed floor-function facts.
